summary: Added a bounded, single-task Live Output read (process_launcher.read_live_output_for_task + aiworkhub_dashboard_task_live_output MCP tool), a repository_bootstrap.py wrapper that provisions task_store's authority set plus the Source Graph directory in one idempotent call, an is_not_initialized_reason() helper so the dashboard never masks a real corruption as 'just click init', closed the VS Code panel-serializer gaps (explicit getMcpClient rebind + stale-controller dispose), and (this residual pass) implemented the media/app.js Live Output renderer/poller: selecting a task starts a single-task requestLiveOutput/liveOutput poll loop that incrementally appends the sanitized stdout tail, replaces the stderr tail, shows liveness/last-activity/exit state, bounds client-retained text to the same 64 KiB the server enforces, and stops on task switch/clear or an ok:false response.

checks.evidence: process_launcher._latest_process_row_for_task filters process_events.jsonl rows by task_id during the scan itself; read_live_output_for_task only ever tails the stdout/stderr paths carried by that ONE matched row -- verified by test_aiworkhub_selected_task_live_output_b855.py's no-fanout test.
read_live_output_for_task accepts cursor/offset, returns next_cursor + truncated, and a second call with the prior next_cursor returns only newly-appended bytes.
_sanitize_live_output_text strips ANSI CSI sequences and C0 control bytes (except \n/\t), redacts 24+ char token-like runs, then HTML-escapes; covered by ANSI/redaction/escaping unit tests.
max_bytes is clamped to MAX_LOG_TAIL_BYTES (64 KiB); a stdout file larger than the requested window sets truncated=true and next_cursor advances only by the bytes actually read.

No process-log row for task_id -> {ok: false, error: output_unavailable, reason: no_process_log_record_for_task}; a row with no stdout/stderr path recorded, or a deleted log file, fail closed the same way -- never raises, never fabricates output.

repository_bootstrap.initialize_repository_full calls task_store.initialize_repository then source_graph.resolve_db_path; a second call against the same repo reports created_canonical_db=False (task_store's own idempotency) and source_graph_ready=True with no destructive re-creation.

dashboard_mcp_app.is_not_initialized_reason returns True only for the 'manifest_invalid:manifest_missing...' reason (a repository that has never been initialized); a corrupted storage registry produces 'registry_invalid:...', for which it returns False, so the dashboard never recommends Init Repo for a genuine corruption.

reviveDashboardPanel disposes any stale panel.__aiworkhubViewState before adopting the newly deserialized panel, and re-binds a fresh McpStdioClient via getMcpClient(context); verified by static source assertions in test_aiworkhub_vscode_reload_restore_b855.py.

getHtmlForWebview renders #initialize-button (Init Repo) before the Model capabilities/#glm-canary-button section; sendRequest is only ever called inside runGlmCanary, gated behind an explicit native 'modal: true' credit-confirmation dialog -- static source assertions in test_aiworkhub_model_diagnostics_b855.py.

requestTaskDetail() now calls startLiveOutputPolling(taskId), which posts requestLiveOutput{taskId, cursor:0} and schedules a bounded LIVE_OUTPUT_POLL_MS=4000 self-poll (scheduleNextLiveOutputPoll) that only continues while that exact taskId stays selected; renderLiveOutput() drops any response whose task_id no longer matches state.liveOutputTaskId (no cross-task fanout), appends the pre-sanitized stdout tail (appendLiveOutputText, bounded to LIVE_OUTPUT_MAX_CLIENT_CHARS=64KiB matching MAX_LIVE_OUTPUT_BYTES server-side), replaces the stderr tail, and renders liveness_state/last_activity_at/exit_code/truncated into #detail-live-output-state; clearTaskDetail()/task-switch call resetLiveOutputPanel() which stops the timer. extension.js's HTML gained a second #detail-live-output-stderr <pre> (styled for free by the existing '.result-block pre' rule -- no CSS file touched).
